scope: Read-only audit of DrivingEditor reference44; no weights download, GPU inference or mask mutation
confirmed: The official demo uses a shadow-fine-tuned SAM ViT-B checkpoint, then an LSTN network for video propagation. The existing general SAM body masks are not this pipeline.
demo_app.py derives bounding-box prompts from a painted first-frame mask. This requires a deliberately selected shadow cue, not just the existing vehicle-body mask.
The README publishes fine-tuned SAM and LSTN model links on Baidu. The git tree contains checkpoint placeholder/log files, not these trained weights. Link download/accessibility was not tested.
These are the cited tool author's implementation and weights references; they do not establish DrivingEditor authors' exact shadow prompts, SAM checkpoint selection or masks.
